info.title: luiskr.com Public Content API
info.description: Read-only machine-readable surface of luiskr.com: documentation content, agent catalogs, sitemaps and linkset discovery. All endpoints are GET-only and require no authentication.

get.description: Structured JSON export of a documentation/source file published by the docs portal (mirrored at /docs).
Curated llms.txt index of the site's agent-relevant content.
Agent-readable catalog of the site's featured content entries.
Linkset of the site's machine-readable API surface.
English sitemap; per-locale sitemaps live at /sitemap-<locale>.xml.

Machine-readable catalog of the site's full-content replica surface — every public route as Markdown and JSON in all 16 languages. Lists per-locale route indexes (/llm/<locale>/routes.json), the addressing conventions (/llm/<locale>/<route>.{md,json} canonical tree plus <route>.md/.json siblings) and the Content-Signal usage policy (ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes).
Human/agent-readable index of the replica surface — same catalog as /llm/index.json in Markdown form.
Every replica route for one locale (en, br, es, de, hrk, cas, riv, gn, it, ru, fr, tln, nl, ca, gl, ga) — route path, page type, title and its .md/.json replica URLs.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale code (en, br, es, de, hrk, cas, riv, gn, it, ru, fr, tln, nl, ca, gl, ga).

get.description: Full-content replica of one public route — append .md for the Markdown replica or .json for the structured JSON replica (e.g. /llm/en/portfolio/metcha.md, /llm/br/lgpd.json). The same replicas are also served as siblings at <route>.md / <route>.json. English routes live under /llm/en/; the docs portal surface is English-only.

parameters.name: routePath
parameters.description: Replica file path ending in .md or .json (e.g. portfolio/metcha.md, docs/shared/src/App.ts.json).
